title: Perfect for price
text: Perfect for price. This is basically a piece of craft fur that was cut in a shape of sheepskin. I am not complaining because it was cheap and does the job for a backdrop or would look cute on a chair in a teen bedroom. My white cat loves it!!

product_metadata.title: HLZHOU Soft Faux Fur Rug White Sheepskin Chair Cover Seat Pad Shaggy Area Rugs for Bedroom Sofa Living Room Floor (Gray, 2.5x4 Feet)
features: Perfect for putting it in your kid's room, living room, bedrooms, playing room adding extra modern to your decor and turns your room into an inviting space with this simple yet classy elegant design.
Material: front side: artificial animal wool; back side: genuine soft white suede backing.
Size: 2x3 ft, Ideal as a rug or draped across your favorite armchair, also perfect for home decor.

Multi-Purpose Usage: Can be used for chairs seat cushion, Kids home living dining bed room rugs decor, Deluxe Super Seat cover etc. This super soft throw rug makes a perfect gift for all occasions and photo prop.
Easy to wash: Use cold water below 30 degrees for cleaning. You can choose machine wash or hand wash. When taking out the fur rug, shake it to make the rug fluffy.
